legend-malta-high-alpine-road.story: official scenic toll road. waterfalls, dam, high alpine. From Gmünd it runs 25 km to Muhr; allow about 27 min of riding. The highest point is about 1,850 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Malta High Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 8 km this is Malta High Alpine Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
